description.value: Vanilla Leaf Bakery Café is Pender Island's only bakery café, baking from-scratch pastries, savouries, and custom cakes daily. Touring cyclists will find hot breakfast items, freshly made sandwiches geared toward hiking and picnics, and grab-and-go catering options. The café has a loyal following among island visitors and offers a rewards loyalty program.

address.value: 4605 Bedwell Harbour Road, Pender Island, BC V0N 2M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is live and consistent with OSM tags: phone, address, and URL all match. The site confirms vegan and gluten-friendly options daily, a dedicated 'Hiking & Picnics: Freshly Made Sandwiches & More' section with an Order Now link, and grab-and-go catering — supporting takeout and packed-lunch claims. No evidence on-site or in OSM for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi (OSM internet_access=yes unconfirmed by website), or charging.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating bakery café on Pender Island with a live website, confirmed contact details, and strong customer reviews. A natural stop for touring cyclists on the Gulf Islands.
